mapper.select: select u.user_id userId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName,d.dept_id deptId,d.dept_name deptName, profile.employment_type employmentType,profile.employment_status employmentStatus,date_format(profile.hire_date,'%Y-%m-%d') hireDate from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id where (d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors)) and (profile.hire_date is null or profile.hire_date<=last_day(concat(#{month},'-01'))) and ((u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')!='LEFT') or exists(select 1 from biz_staff_cost_policy c where c.user_id=u.user_id and c.status='ACTIVE' and c.effective_from<=last_day(concat(#{month},'-01')) and (c.effective_to is null or c.effective_to>=concat(#{month},'-01')))) order by d.order_num,u.user_id

select distinct p.project_id from biz_project p where (p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or exists(select 1 from biz_project_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id where m.project_id=p.project_id and (d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors)))) and coalesce(p.actual_start_date,p.plan_start_date,'1900-01-01')<=last_day(concat(#{month},'-01')) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date>=concat(#{month},'-01')) order by p.project_id

select f.fact_id factId,f.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,f.description,f.amount from biz_operating_fact f join biz_project p on p.project_id=f.project_id where f.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and f.currency=#{currency} and date_format(f.biz_date,'%Y-%m')=#{month} and f.fact_kind='COST' and f.status='CONFIRMED' and f.amount>0 and f.category_code!='COMPANY_PUBLIC_COST' order by f.fact_id
select bill_id from biz_public_expense_month where recognition_mode='DAILY_V1' and bill_month<=date_format(current_date(),'%Y-%m') order by company_dept_id,bill_id
select bill_id billId,project_id projectId,date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m-%d') bizDate,amount,status from biz_public_expense_daily where bill_id=#{billId} order by project_id,biz_date
mapper.insert: insert into biz_public_expense_daily(bill_id,project_id,biz_date,amount,status) values(#{billId},#{projectId},#{bizDate},#{amount},#{status}) on duplicate key update amount=values(amount),status=values(status)
mapper.delete: delete from biz_public_expense_daily where bill_id=#{billId} and project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate}
mapper.select: select distinct d.project_id projectId,date_format(d.biz_date,'%Y-%m-%d') bizDate from biz_public_expense_daily d join biz_project p on p.project_id=d.project_id left join biz_project_daily_result r on r.project_id=d.project_id and r.biz_date=d.biz_date and r.is_current='1' where d.bill_id=#{billId} and d.biz_date<=current_date() and coalesce(p.accounting_state,'OPEN')='OPEN' and (r.result_id is null or r.public_cost!=(select sum(x.amount) from biz_public_expense_daily x where x.project_id=d.project_id and x.biz_date=d.biz_date))

select coalesce(sum(amount),0) amount,coalesce(sum(case when status='ESTIMATED' then amount else 0 end),0) estimatedAmount, (select coalesce(sum(f.amount),0) from biz_operating_fact f join biz_public_expense_month b on cast(b.bill_id as char)=f.source_id where f.project_id=#{projectId} and f.biz_date=#{bizDate} and f.category_code='COMPANY_PUBLIC_COST' and f.source_type='PUBLIC_EXPENSE' and b.recognition_mode='DAILY_V1' and f.status in('CONFIRMED','REVERSED')) monthlyFactAmount from biz_public_expense_daily where project_id=#{projectId} and biz_date=#{bizDate}

select coalesce(sum(case when date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m')=#{month} and biz_date<=current_date() then amount else 0 end),0) accruedMonthAmount, coalesce(sum(case when biz_date<=current_date() then amount else 0 end),0) accruedLifetimeAmount, coalesce(sum(case when date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m')=#{month} and biz_date<=current_date() and status='ESTIMATED' then amount else 0 end),0) estimatedMonthAmount, coalesce(sum(case when biz_date=current_date() and date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m')=#{month} then amount else 0 end),0) todayAmount, exists(select 1 from biz_public_expense_month b join biz_project p on p.company_dept_id=b.company_dept_id and p.base_currency=b.currency where p.project_id=#{projectId} and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.recognition_mode='DAILY_V1') dailyRecognition from biz_public_expense_daily where project_id=#{projectId}

select date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m-%d') bizDate,sum(amount) amount,case when sum(status='ESTIMATED')>0 then 'ESTIMATED' else 'CONFIRMED' end status,biz_date<=current_date() accrued from biz_public_expense_daily where project_id=#{projectId} and date_format(biz_date,'%Y-%m')=#{month} group by biz_date order by biz_date
select d.dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,d.leader_user_id leaderUserId from sys_dept d where d.parent_id=100 and d.status='0' and d.del_flag='0' and order by d.order_num,d.dept_id
select dept_id companyDeptId,dept_name companyName,leader_user_id leaderUserId from sys_dept where dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and parent_id=100 and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select d.dept_id deptId,d.dept_name deptName,d.parent_id parentId from sys_dept d where d.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' and d.dept_id!=#{companyDeptId} and find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors) order by d.order_num,d.dept_id

select distinct u.user_id userId,coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name) userName,d.dept_id deptId,d.dept_name deptName from sys_user u join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=u.dept_id and d.del_flag='0' and d.status='0' left join biz_staff_profile profile on profile.user_id=u.user_id where u.del_flag='0' and u.status='0' and (d.dept_id=#{companyDeptId} or find_in_set(#{companyDeptId},d.ancestors)) and coalesce(profile.employment_status,'ACTIVE')!='LEFT' and (exists(select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where ur.user_id=u.user_id and r.role_key='project_owner' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from biz_project p where p.main_owner_user_id=u.user_id and p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and p.del_flag='0')) order by u.user_id

select p.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.main_owner_user_id ownerUserId,p.base_currency currency,p.accounting_state accountingState from biz_project p where p.del_flag='0' and p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and coalesce(p.accounting_state,'OPEN')='OPEN' and (p.delivery_policy_version='SEPARATED_V1' or p.status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED')) and coalesce(p.actual_start_date,p.plan_start_date,'1900-01-01') <= last_day(concat(#{month},'-01')) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date >= concat(#{month},'-01')) and p.main_owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} and p.base_currency=#{currency} order by p.project_id
mapper.sql: policy_id policyId,company_dept_id companyDeptId,name,category,period_type periodType,amount,currency,start_month startMonth,end_month endMonth,estimated,status,remark,attachment_urls attachmentUrls,version
mapper.select: select from biz_public_expense_policy where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} order by policy_id desc
select from biz_public_expense_policy where policy_id=#{policyId} for update
mapper.update: update biz_public_expense_policy set name=#{name},category=#{category},period_type=#{periodType},amount=#{amount},currency=#{currency},start_month=#{startMonth},end_month=#{endMonth},estimated=#{estimated},status=#{status},remark=#{remark},attachment_urls=#{attachmentUrls},version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=now() where policy_id=#{policyId} and version=#{version}
mapper.sql: b.bill_id billId,b.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,b.bill_month month,b.currency,b.total_amount totalAmount,b.personnel_amount personnelAmount,b.personnel_snapshot personnelSnapshot,b.status,b.version,b.recognition_mode recognitionMode,b.settled_time settledTime,b.settled_user_name settledUserName
mapper.select: select from biz_public_expense_month b join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where b.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.currency=#{currency}
select from biz_public_expense_month b join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where b.bill_id=#{billId}
select from biz_public_expense_month b join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where b.bill_id=#{billId} for update
select from biz_public_expense_month b join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where b.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} order by b.bill_month desc,b.currency limit 120
mapper.update: update biz_public_expense_month set total_amount=#{totalAmount},personnel_amount=#{personnelAmount},personnel_snapshot=#{personnelSnapshot},status=#{status},version=version+1,update_time=now(),settled_time=coalesce(settled_time,now()),settled_user_id=coalesce(settled_user_id,#{userId}),settled_user_name=coalesce(settled_user_name,#{userName}) where bill_id=#{billId} and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select entry_id entryId,bill_id billId,policy_id policyId,policy_version policyVersion,name,category,amount,estimated,remark,attachment_urls attachmentUrls from biz_public_expense_entry where bill_id=#{billId} order by entry_id
mapper.update: update biz_public_expense_entry set amount=#{amount},estimated=#{estimated},remark=#{remark} where entry_id=#{entryId} and bill_id=#{billId}
mapper.sql: o.allocation_id allocationId,o.bill_id billId,o.owner_user_id ownerUserId,o.owner_name ownerName,o.cost_pool costPool,o.dept_id deptId,o.dept_name deptName,o.percentage,o.amount,o.status,o.version,o.submitted_time submittedTime
mapper.select: select from biz_public_expense_owner o where o.bill_id=#{billId} order by o.allocation_id
select from biz_public_expense_owner o where o.allocation_id=#{allocationId}

select ,b.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName,b.bill_month month,b.currency,b.total_amount totalAmount,b.status billStatus from biz_public_expense_owner o join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=o.bill_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where o.owner_user_id=#{userId} and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.status in('PUBLISHED','SETTLED') order by b.company_dept_id,b.currency
mapper.update: update biz_public_expense_owner set status=#{status},version=version+1,submitted_time=case when #{status}='SUBMITTED' then now() else null end where allocation_id=#{allocationId} and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select project_allocation_id projectAllocationId,allocation_id allocationId,project_id projectId,project_name projectName,percentage,amount,accounting_fact_id accountingFactId from biz_public_expense_project where allocation_id=#{allocationId} order by project_allocation_id
mapper.delete: delete p from biz_public_expense_project p join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.allocation_id=p.allocation_id where o.bill_id=#{billId}
mapper.sql: a.adjustment_id adjustmentId,a.bill_id billId,a.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,a.amount,a.reason,a.request_key requestKey,a.accounting_fact_id accountingFactId,a.operator_name operatorName,a.create_time createTime,b.bill_month month,b.currency
mapper.select: select from biz_public_expense_adjustment a join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=a.bill_id join biz_project p on p.project_id=a.project_id where a.bill_id=#{billId} and a.request_key=#{requestKey}

select from biz_public_expense_adjustment a join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=a.bill_id join biz_project p on p.project_id=a.project_id where 1=1 and a.bill_id=#{billId}and a.project_id=#{projectId} order by a.adjustment_id desc
mapper.update: update biz_public_expense_adjustment set accounting_fact_id=#{accountingFactId} where adjustment_id=#{adjustmentId}
mapper.select: select event_id eventId,bill_id billId,event_type eventType,operator_name operatorName,reason,snapshot,create_time createTime from biz_public_expense_event where company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} and (bill_id=#{billId} or bill_id is null) order by event_id desc limit 100
mapper.sql: from biz_public_expense_month b join biz_project p on p.company_dept_id=b.company_dept_id and p.base_currency=b.currency where p.project_id=#{projectId} and b.status != 'SETTLED' and b.total_amount > 0 and b.bill_month <= date_format(current_date(),'%Y-%m') and coalesce(p.actual_start_date,p.plan_start_date,'1900-01-01') <= last_day(concat(b.bill_month,'-01')) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date >= concat(b.bill_month,'-01')) and (b.status='DRAFT' or exists(select 1 from biz_public_expense_owner o where o.bill_id=b.bill_id and ((o.owner_user_id=p.main_owner_user_id and o.status='DRAFT' and o.amount > 0) or exists(select 1 from biz_public_expense_project a where a.allocation_id=o.allocation_id and a.project_id=p.project_id and a.amount > 0))))

select a.n+b.n*10+c.n*100 n from (select 0 n union all select 1 union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7 union all select 8 union all select 9) a cross join (select 0 n union all select 1 union all select 2 union all select 3 union all select 4 union all select 5 union all select 6 union all select 7 union all select 8 union all select 9) b cross join (select 0 n union all select 1 union all select 2 union all select 3) c

from biz_public_expense_policy policy join biz_project p on p.company_dept_id=policy.company_dept_id and p.base_currency=policy.currency cross join () months where p.project_id=#{projectId} and policy.status='ACTIVE' and policy.amount > 0 and date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month) <= concat(policy.end_month,'-01') and date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month) <= current_date() and coalesce(p.actual_start_date,p.plan_start_date,'1900-01-01') <= last_day(date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month)) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date >= date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month)) and not exists(select 1 from biz_public_expense_month existing where existing.company_dept_id=policy.company_dept_id and existing.currency=policy.currency and existing.bill_month=date_format(date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month),'%Y-%m'))
mapper.select: select (select count(*) )+(select count(distinct date_format(date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month),'%Y-%m')) )

select count(*) from biz_public_expense_month b join biz_project p on p.company_dept_id=b.company_dept_id and p.base_currency=b.currency join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.bill_id=b.bill_id and o.owner_user_id=p.main_owner_user_id where p.project_id=#{projectId} and b.status='PUBLISHED' and o.status!='SUBMITTED' and o.amount > 0 and coalesce(p.actual_start_date,p.plan_start_date,'1900-01-01') <= last_day(concat(b.bill_month,'-01')) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date >= concat(b.bill_month,'-01'))

select p.project_id projectId,p.base_currency currency,#{month} month, (select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_project a join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.allocation_id=a.allocation_id join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=o.bill_id where a.project_id=p.project_id and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.status in('PUBLISHED','SETTLED')) +(select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_adjustment a join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=a.bill_id where a.project_id=p.project_id and b.bill_month=#{month}) monthAmount, (select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_project a join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.allocation_id=a.allocation_id join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=o.bill_id where a.project_id=p.project_id and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.status='SETTLED') +(select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_adjustment a join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=a.bill_id where a.project_id=p.project_id and b.bill_month=#{month}) settledMonthAmount, (select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_project a join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.allocation_id=a.allocation_id join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=o.bill_id where a.project_id=p.project_id and b.status='SETTLED') +(select coalesce(sum(a.amount),0) from biz_public_expense_adjustment a where a.project_id=p.project_id) lifetimeAmount, exists(select 1 from biz_public_expense_month b where b.company_dept_id=p.company_dept_id and b.bill_month=#{month} and b.currency=p.base_currency and b.status in('PUBLISHED','SETTLED')) hasPublishedBill, (select count(*) and b.bill_month=#{month}) +(select count(distinct policy.currency) and date_format(date_add(concat(policy.start_month,'-01'),interval months.n month),'%Y-%m')=#{month}) pendingCount from biz_project p where p.project_id=#{projectId} and p.del_flag='0'

select b.bill_id billId,b.bill_month month,b.currency,b.status,o.owner_name ownerName,o.cost_pool costPool,o.dept_name deptName,a.percentage,a.amount,d.dept_name companyName from biz_public_expense_project a join biz_public_expense_owner o on o.allocation_id=a.allocation_id join biz_public_expense_month b on b.bill_id=o.bill_id join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=b.company_dept_id where a.project_id=#{projectId} and b.status in('PUBLISHED','SETTLED') order by b.bill_month desc,b.bill_id
